noSchematics: No generator installed in the project
featured.componentHint: Component with template, style and test

recent.title: Used recently

preview.title: Preview (--dry-run)
preview.nothing: Nothing to do: the files already exist, identical.
preview.conflict: The file already exists with different content: the CLI won't overwrite it

add.title: Add a library with ng add
add.hint: npm name, with an optional version or tag (@angular/material, @ngrx/store@19). The library's questions get their default answers; if the package is already installed and declares options, they show up below.
add.options: ng add options of the package:
updates.title: Updates with ng update
updates.loading: ng update is reading the npm registry…
updates.none: All the Angular packages are up to date.
dirty.title: Uncommitted changes in Git

dirty.text.one: {count} file is changed and not committed yet. Better commit first, so the changes of the CLI stay separate.
dirty.text.other: {count} files are changed and not committed yet. Better commit first, so the changes of the CLI stay separate.

errors.not_installed: The Angular CLI is not installed in {project}: run npm install
errors.collection_not_found: Schematic collection "{collection}" is not installed in the project

errors.options_invalid: The options must be an object
